variant_understanding_failure.definition: Agent fails to understand or satisfy user's requested product variant constraints.
trigger_patterns: User specifies product attributes such as size, color, capacity, model, compatibility.
Agent selects or processes an item that does not satisfy those constraints.

positive_example.scenario: User wants a laptop exchange with specific capacity and configuration.
positive_example.wrong_behavior: Agent selects a replacement laptop with different capacity or configuration without confirming.

negative_example.scenario: User requested a product variant that is unavailable.
negative_example.correct_behavior: Agent explains available alternatives or transfers to human support.

scope_confirmation_failure.definition: Agent performs actions beyond the user's confirmed scope or fails to resolve ambiguous operation scope.
trigger_patterns: User specifies only certain items or operations.
Agent executes broader action without confirmation.

positive_example.scenario: User wants to cancel one item from an order.

negative_example.scenario: User clearly confirms all items before processing.

policy_violation.definition: Agent performs an action that conflicts with benchmark policy even if tools allow execution.
trigger_patterns: Agent fails to block or correct invalid operation.

positive_example.scenario: Tool allows an exchange but benchmark policy forbids this exchange type.

negative_example.scenario: Tool execution succeeds and policy requirements are satisfied.

golden_mismatch.definition: Trajectory differs from benchmark expected behavior due to mismatch between simulator expectation and gold annotation.
trigger_patterns: Failure comes from deviation from benchmark expected result.

positive_example.scenario: Agent completes a reasonable action but benchmark expects another outcome.
positive_example.wrong_behavior: Agent trajectory differs from gold expectation.
